info.title: Junction Mobile API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/

tags.name: offers
tags.description: Offers are bookable suggestions for a trip.

post.description: Used to create an Order and book the specified Offers.
Used to initiate a search for offers based on the provided Offer Search context.

get.description: Used to retrieve all Offer results for an Offer Search.

get.description: Used to retrieve orders created by a user.

parameters.name: query[name]
parameters.description: Used as a key to search relevant places. Ex. key: 'lon' should match London

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Target userId you want to change the password

get.summary: Return the information of the user

page-cursor.name: page[cursor]
page-cursor.description: Pagination cursor that defines your place in the list.

page-limit.name: page[limit]
page-limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

TripSearch.title: Trip Search
TripSearch.description: Context for which Trips can be found.

Place.title: Place
Place.description:
A place is an indexed reference to a location that Junction might have related content for. It is specified in a trip search to state where a passenger wishes to travel from/to. Each place is allocated a unique identifier.

Places are curated by feeds from GTFS sources.  A place can be a rail station, Airport...

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like `title``, this field’s value can be localized.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

source.description: An object containing references to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

TripOfferSearch.title: Trip Offer Search
TripOfferSearch.description: Context for which Trip-related Offers can be found.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: Offer for one or more segments. Used for creating an Order.

OfferSegmentDetails.title: Offer Segment Details
OfferSegmentDetails.description: Specific details for an offer on a specific segment.

CabinClassDetails.title: Cabin Class Details
CabinClassDetails.description: Internal and marketing name of a cabin class.

OfferSegment.title: Offer Segment
OfferSegment.description: Segment related to a grouped offer.

RouteIdentifiers.title: Route Identifiers
RouteIdentifiers.description: Route identifiers that the operator (operating) and vendor (marketing) uses, i.e. operating flight number and marketing flight number or vice versa for train or buss line numbers.

Leg.title: Leg
Leg.description: Smallest part of a Trip; A scheduled departure from A and a scheduled arrival to B.

OfferSegmentLeg.title: Offer Segment Leg
OfferSegmentLeg.description: Leg related to a grouped offers segments.

OfferAggregate.title: OfferAggregate
OfferAggregate.description: Result of searching for offers. Used for creating an Order. Chose one offer from each group when creating an order.

OfferGroup.title: Offer Group
OfferGroup.description: Result of searching for offers. Used for creating an Order. Chose one offer when creating an order.
